description:
HushTumblr v0.0.8: 44 patches for Tumblr 46.5.0.109, which needs Android 8 or newer. It adds switches to hide blog notification reminders and gift purchase pop-ups, takes the counts off a post's notes tabs with Hide note counts and lets you hide Quick setups from the settings home. Validation: 982 runtime tests passed. All 249 patch tests passed. All 44 patches applied without forcing to Tumblr 46.5.0.109. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Tumblr APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Tumblr password.

### What's new

* **Tumblr:** New **Hide blog notification reminders** switch on the Interface page, off by default. It hides the pop-up on a blog that asks you to turn on notifications for it. Your subscriptions and notification settings don't change.
* **Tumblr:** New **Hide gift purchase popups** switch on the Interface page, off by default. It hides the pop-up on a blog that suggests buying the blog a gift. Crab tips still show, and the gift button on a blog still opens the gift screen.
* **Tumblr:** Hide note counts now takes the numbers off the Comments, Reblogs and Likes tabs on a post's notes too. The tabs still switch, and the numbers come back once the switch is off and the notes are opened again.
* **Tumblr:** Quick setups can be hidden from the settings home with a long press on its row, and its help line now says so. The **Quick setups on the home page** row on Pause, backup and diagnostics brings it back. The choice stays out of settings backups and Quick setups, and Pause leaves it alone.
* **Tumblr:** The Words to hide and Allowed words editors now shrink to fit above the keyboard. With large text and the Samsung keyboard open, Save and Cancel used to sit behind the keyboard.
* **Tumblr:** Manage muted posts and Clear diagnostic data now read the file back after saving and only say it worked once the new copy is really there. If that check fails, Manage muted posts reloads the list so it shows what's actually saved, says it couldn't update, and lets you try again.

### Behind the scenes

* **Tooling:** Patch runs check much more of what they build. Every Tumblr method, field and resource a run changes has to match a reviewed contract or allowlist line, and the bundle, merged APK, patched APK and report stay locked so nothing else on the PC can swap them mid-run. The release receipt patches every fixture itself, and `patch-for-device.ps1` checks the signing key and takes `-Option` for patch options.
* **Tooling:** Release checks now refuse malformed vulnerability answers, and a low severity label can't hide a score they can't read. A GitHub description that names no version, count or build is left as written. Morphe Manager's description carries the release's full changelog, and the README matches the published patches. Each release now writes the README's checksum example from the signed bundle, so its label, hash and file name can't fall behind.

patches.name: Dark background color
patches.description: Makes the background of Tumblr's Dark Mode palette black, which can save battery on OLED screens, or another dark color you pick when patching. Other palettes stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

options.description: The color the Dark Mode palette's background turns, as a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #121212. Leave it blank for black. Cards get the same color and highlighted parts a slightly lighter one. Grays up to #3F3F3F work, and lighter colors are refused so text stays readable.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off Firebase crash reports and Google's analytics collection, and Tumblr's own tracking and ad measurement once it restarts. The Firebase and Google part stays until you patch again without it. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable update prompts
patches.description: Stops Tumblr asking Google Play for a newer version and showing Play's update prompt. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Updates.

patches.name: Filter activity notifications
patches.description: Hides selected likes, reblogs, replies, follows, mentions, asks and boops from the activity list as pages load. Each switch starts off. Choose them in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Notifications.

patches.name: Fix push notifications
patches.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Firebase can refuse a patched Tumblr whose request doesn't name Tumblr's original signature, so this sends its fingerprint. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Notifications.

patches.name: Hide Blaze prompts
patches.description: Hides the prompts to pay for Blaze, Tumblr's way to promote a post. That covers the Blaze buttons on your blog and dashboard, the nudge after you post, and the Blaze banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Hide Tumblr TV
patches.description: Takes the Tumblr TV tab out of the bottom bar, and stops sign-up from sending you there. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Hide Watch it rows
patches.description: Takes Tumblr TV's Watch it rows and video hub cards out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Takes ad cards and paid Blaze posts out of your dashboard and other feeds, and stops Tumblr asking its ad networks for more. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide advertising ID
patches.description: Tumblr and the ad companies inside it see an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you'd deleted your ad ID in Android. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide blog notification reminders
patches.description: Hides the pop-up suggesting you turn on notifications for a blog. Your subscriptions and notification settings stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Hide filtered posts
patches.description: Takes the posts Tumblr covers with "This post contains filtered content" out of your dashboard, searches and other feeds, so your filtered tags and words hide them completely. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide gift purchase popups
patches.description: Hides the pop-up suggesting you buy a gift for a blog. You can still open gifting yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Hide hashtags
patches.description: Takes the tags off the bottom of posts in your dashboard, other feeds and Tumblr TV, and keeps the source link. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Hide note counts
patches.description: Takes the like, reblog and comment counts off the footer under posts, community posts included, and the counts off the top of a post's notes and its tabs. The buttons stay and still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Hide photo posts
patches.description: Takes photo posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with pictures and no video, its reblog trail included, counts as a photo post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide posts with these words
patches.description: Hides posts matching your word list. Choose whether to check current text, the reblog trail, tags or summaries. Allowed words can keep a matching post, but other enabled filters still apply. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide reblogs
patches.description: Takes reblogs out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads, and keeps the posts people made themselves. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested blogs
patches.description: Takes the blogs Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, whether as cards, rows or carousels, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested communities
patches.description: Takes the communities Tumblr suggests you join out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested tags
patches.description: Takes the tags Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide text posts
patches.description: Takes text posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with no pictures or video, its reblog trail included, counts as a text post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the Communities tab
patches.description: Takes the Communities tab out of the bottom bar and stops the Communities tips in the post editor. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Hide the Explore tab
patches.description: Takes the Explore and search button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Hide the Follow button
patches.description: Takes the Follow button out of the header of posts from blogs you don't follow yet. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Hide the Notifications tab
patches.description: Takes the Notifications button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Hide the Save button
patches.description: Takes the Save button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, when Tumblr shows one. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Hide the ad-free banner
patches.description: Hides the banner on your dashboard that asks you to pay for Ad-Free Browsing. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the comment button
patches.description: Takes the comment button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Hide the diamond and TumblrMart
patches.description: Hides the Premium diamond and the TumblrMart button at the top of your dashboard, Explore and notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Hide the like button
patches.description: Takes the like button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, and the reactions off community posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Hide the reblog button
patches.description: Takes the reblog button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Hide the share button
patches.description: Takes the share button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Hide unread dots
patches.description: Hides the unread dots and counts on the bottom bar's Dashboard, Communities and Notifications tabs, with a switch for each tab. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Hide video posts
patches.description: Takes video posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with a video anywhere in it, its reblog trail included, counts as a video post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: HushTumblr settings
patches.description: Adds a HushTumblr page where you turn features on or off, pause HushTumblr, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Tumblr logo at the top of your dashboard, from Tumblr's Settings or by long-pressing the Tumblr icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Mute posts locally
patches.description: Adds a local mute action to post menus. Originals and their reblogs stay hidden for this account. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Tumblr, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Reorder the bottom bar
patches.description: Puts the bottom bar's tabs in an order you pick, from a list in its settings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Reveal allowed mature content
patches.description: Removes mature-content covers only when Tumblr explicitly allows them for the signed-in adult account. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Show mutual markers
patches.description: Marks blogs that follow your primary blog when you follow them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Show post timestamps
patches.description: Shows when posts were made using Tumblr's own timestamp layout. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches.name: Skip review prompts
patches.description: Stops the pop-up that asks what you think of the Tumblr app and then asks you for a store rating or feedback. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Tumblr's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Turn off screenshot sharing
patches.description: Stops Tumblr watching for screenshots, so taking one doesn't bring up its offer to save the post as an image. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches.name: Visible image descriptions
patches.description: Shows author-provided image descriptions below each image, including galleries and reblogs. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

release_notes:
HushTumblr 0.0.8 has 44 patches for Tumblr 46.5.0.109. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer.

Two patches are new: Hide blog notification reminders and Hide gift purchase popups. They're in the default selection, and both stay off until you turn them on from the Interface page in HushTumblr settings. Hide note counts now clears the numbers on a post's notes tabs as well, and Quick setups can be tucked away with a long press if you don't use it.

Coming from 0.0.7, patch Tumblr 46.5.0.109 with the default selection and install it over your current build. Your settings stay. Coming from stock Tumblr, uninstall it first, then install the patched app and sign in with your email.

## What's new

- New **Hide blog notification reminders** switch on the Interface page, off by default. It hides the pop-up on a blog that asks you to turn on notifications for it. Your subscriptions and notification settings don't change.
- New **Hide gift purchase popups** switch on the Interface page, off by default. It hides the pop-up on a blog that suggests buying the blog a gift. Crab tips still show, and the gift button on a blog still opens the gift screen.
- Hide note counts now takes the numbers off the Comments, Reblogs and Likes tabs on a post's notes too. The tabs still switch, and the numbers come back once the switch is off and the notes are opened again.
- Quick setups can be hidden from the settings home with a long press on its row, and its help line now says so. The **Quick setups on the home page** row on Pause, backup and diagnostics brings it back. The choice stays out of settings backups and Quick setups, and Pause leaves it alone.
- The Words to hide and Allowed words editors now shrink to fit above the keyboard. With large text and the Samsung keyboard open, Save and Cancel used to sit behind the keyboard.
- Manage muted posts and Clear diagnostic data now read the file back after saving and only say it worked once the new copy is really there. If that check fails, Manage muted posts reloads the list so it shows what's actually saved, says it couldn't update, and lets you try again.

## Behind the scenes

- Patch runs check much more of what they build. Every Tumblr method, field and resource a run changes has to match a reviewed contract or allowlist line, and the bundle, merged APK, patched APK and report stay locked so nothing else on the PC can swap them mid-run. The release receipt patches every fixture itself, and `patch-for-device.ps1` checks the signing key and takes `-Option` for patch options.
- Release checks now refuse malformed vulnerability answers, and a low severity label can't hide a score they can't read. A GitHub description that names no version, count or build is left as written. Morphe Manager's description carries the release's full changelog, and the README matches the published patches. Each release now writes the README's checksum example from the signed bundle, so its label, hash and file name can't fall behind.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Tumblr APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushTumblr release key, fingerprint `2143 368A A5CE 6E5D FFEA  79CF BBC1 3768 83CF 3AB4`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr#verify-a-download).

## Validation

All 982 extension tests, 145 patch tests and 104 tests against the real Tumblr 46.5.0.109 build passed for this release, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Tumblr 46.5.0.109 build with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 44 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.8.json` records that result, the build's hashes and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Before the release, all 44 patches were also run on an Android 16 emulator signed in to a test account. A long press on the Tumblr logo opened the settings. Both new switches showed up on the Interface page, started off and turned on and off without needing a restart. With Hide note counts on, a post's notes tabs showed only their icons, and the numbers came back once it was off. Quick setups hid with a long press and came back from the Pause, backup and diagnostics page. Tumblr picks when to show the blog reminder and gift pop-ups, and neither came up for the test account during the check, so those two patches rest on the tests against the real build.
